_about: Travel pacing (feat/travel-pacing, 2026-11-16). The owner: 'I dont want it to go day by day when travel could be a month long but instead every few days you can roll an event'. A journey runs in stretches of `stretch_days`; each stretch rolls `percent` once (pro rata for a short last stretch); on a hit a hidden die picks the day inside the stretch and `bands` picks the event. Quiet stretches pass in one line. Read by rules/ontheway.py (`stretches`, `road_stretches`, `sea_stretches`); every number here is the app's own and stated as such, the sources it was shaped against are in that module's docstring. `danger` bands widen with the place's volatility (`ontheway._weighed`); `waters` says which open water a sea band happens on.
